examFormat.zh: 6 次测验都在平时上课时间考。测验 1、2、4、5 各 50 分钟（测验 3 和 6 是 100 分钟，另含实验测试）。每次测验两部分：30 道选择题考教材，简答题考讲课内容。教材选择题和讲课简答题各占总成绩 21%（各 6 次，各去掉最低的一次）。期末考试 160 道选择题，全部基于教材，占 33%。
examFormat.en: All six term tests are written during regular class time. Tests 1, 2, 4 and 5 last 50 minutes (Tests 3 and 6 last 100 minutes and add a lab test). Each test has 30 multiple-choice questions on the textbook and short-answer questions on the lecture material. The textbook tests and the lecture tests are worth 21% each (six of each, lowest dropped). The final exam is 160 multiple-choice questions based on the textbook, worth 33%.

note.zh: 按大纲组卷：50 分钟，30 道教材选择题 + 讲课简答题。大纲没写简答题有几道、选择题有几个选项，这里先按 3 道简答、每题 4 个选项（和教材课后题一样）来练。
note.en: Built from the syllabus: 50 minutes, 30 multiple-choice questions on the textbook plus short answers on the lectures. The syllabus does not say how many short-answer questions there are or how many options each question has; this paper uses 3 short answers and 4 options, like the textbook's own quizzes.

detail.zh: LEC0101 和 LEC0102：11 月 16 日周一，在平时上课时间考（LEC0101 上午 11 点，LEC0102 下午 1 点），50 分钟。30 道教材选择题 + 讲课简答题。LEC0103 已在 11 月 3 日考过。
detail.en: LEC0101 and LEC0102: Monday Nov 16 during regular lecture time (LEC0101 11 am, LEC0102 1 pm), 50 minutes. 30 multiple-choice questions on the textbook plus short answers on the lectures. LEC0103 wrote it on Nov 3.

name.zh: 测验 3（第 7、8、9 章）+ 实验测试 1

detail.zh: LEC0101 和 LEC0102：12 月 8 日周二（感恩节停课的补课日）；LEC0103：12 月 1 日。100 分钟，另含实验测试（简答题）。本站暂未收录第 7–9 章。
detail.en: LEC0101 and LEC0102: Tuesday Dec 8 (the make-up day for the Thanksgiving classes); LEC0103: Dec 1. 100 minutes, including a short-answer lab test. Chapters 7-9 are not in the station yet.

detail.zh: 6 次测验，每次 30 道选择题，考教材章节；去掉最低的一次。
detail.en: Six tests of 30 multiple-choice questions on the textbook chapters; the lowest is dropped.

detail.zh: 6 次测验的简答题部分，考讲课内容；去掉最低的一次。
detail.en: The short-answer part of the six tests, on the lecture material; the lowest is dropped.

detail.zh: 2 次实验测试各 5%，实验报告 5%，实验参与 5%（10 次实验），2 次图书馆检索作业共 1%。
detail.en: Two lab tests (5% each), a lab report (5%), lab participation (5%, ten labs) and two library assignments (1%).

detail.zh: 每学期参加 3 小时心理学研究（各 2%），也可以用替代作业代替。
detail.en: Three hours of research participation each term (2% each), or substitute assignments instead.

detail.zh: 4 月考试周，160 道选择题，全部基于教材；具体日期以教务处公布为准。
detail.en: April exam period, 160 multiple-choice questions based on the textbook; the date is set by the Office of the Registrar.

oneLiner.zh: 感官把光、声音、压力、化学物质等能量变成神经信号（感觉），大脑再把这些信号组织、解释成有意义的世界（知觉）；本章逐一讲视觉、听觉、皮肤感觉、味觉、嗅觉和平衡感。
oneLiner.en: The senses turn energy such as light, sound, pressure and chemicals into neural signals (sensation), and the brain organizes and interprets them (perception); the chapter covers vision, hearing, the skin senses, taste, smell and balance.

oneLiner.zh: 意识＝在“唤醒”状态下对内外世界的觉察，它有高低不同的层次；睡眠大约每 90–100 分钟在 N1、N2、N3 和 REM 之间循环一轮，梦有四种主要解释；药物（抑制剂、兴奋剂、致幻剂）、催眠和冥想都能改变意识。
oneLiner.en: Consciousness is awareness under a condition of arousal and has different levels; sleep cycles through N1, N2, N3 and REM about every 90 to 100 minutes, dreams have four main explanations, and drugs, hypnosis and meditation can all alter consciousness.

oneLiner.zh: 学习是经验带来的相对持久的行为改变：可以靠一个刺激反复出现（习惯化、敏感化），靠两个刺激配对（经典条件反射），靠行为的后果（操作性条件反射），也能靠看别人（观察学习）；认知、生物、文化和心态都会影响学习。
oneLiner.en: Learning is a relatively permanent change in behaviour that comes from experience: through one repeated stimulus, through pairing stimuli (classical conditioning), through consequences (operant conditioning) or by watching others (observational learning), shaped by cognition, biology, culture and mindset.
